name: Sophie Dubois
bio:
Sophie Dubois discovered her passion for catering somewhat later in life, after years of managing a small family bistro in rural France. A chance encounter with a racing team passing through her village ignited her interest in motorsport. She was captivated by the energy and precision of the sport, and saw an opportunity to apply her culinary skills in a fast-paced environment. 

Sophie approaches her role with a holistic vision, believing that high-quality, nutritious meals are essential for team performance. She focuses on sourcing local ingredients and creating menus that cater to the diverse dietary needs and preferences of the team. While new to the motorsport scene, Sophie is determined to elevate the catering experience, contributing to a positive and productive atmosphere for everyone involved. She is known for her unwavering dedication to fresh ingredients and her commitment to understanding the dietary needs of the team, ensuring everyone is fueled for success.

physical.description: Sophie is a petite woman with a warm smile and kind eyes.

quirks: Insists on brewing her own herbal teas for the team.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas.
Has a habit of humming French folk songs while preparing meals.
